select i.billing_money billMoney,(i.billing_money - i.billing_money / b.tax_rate) billMoneyTax,e.id proId,e.enum_name proName,b.business_type commpanyId, c.name commpanyName from billing_apply_imgs i left join billing_apply b on i.bill_id = b.id LEFT JOIN billing_apply_corporation c on c.id=b.billing_type left join common_enum e on b.billing_enum = e.enum_code and e.parent_id = 76 where i.state in (1,3) and i.create_time is not null and b.billing_type is not null
and date_format(i.create_time,'%Y-%m') >= date_format(#{startTime,jdbcType=DATE},'%Y-%m')
and date_format(i.create_time,'%Y-%m') <= date_format(#{endTime,jdbcType=DATE},'%Y-%m')

select a.money accMoney,a.money * b.tax_rate accMoneyTax,e.id proId,e.enum_name proName,b.business_type commpanyId ,c.name commpanyName from billing_apply_accounts a left join billing_apply b on a.bill_id = b.id LEFT JOIN billing_apply_corporation c on c.id=b.billing_type left join common_enum e on b.billing_enum = e.enum_code and e.parent_id = 76 where a.state = 1 and a.create_time is not null and b.billing_type is not null
and date_format(a.account_time,'%Y-%m') >= date_format(#{startTime,jdbcType=DATE},'%Y-%m')
and date_format(a.account_time,'%Y-%m') <= date_format(#{endTime,jdbcType=DATE},'%Y-%m')
